changelog: Ready for Print can now be set by hand when the customer approves the design in person at the counter — tick “Customer approved in person” on the job's status box instead of waiting for them to approve the online proof. The job then flows through every later stage without asking again, and who vouched for it is recorded.

Priority is now colour-coded everywhere: URGENT and RUSH show in red with the row tinted, NORMAL shows in green — on the orders list, Job Board, My Jobs, customer page, order page and the printed job card.

Simplified the job stages: Pending, Quality Check, Out for Delivery and On Hold have been removed. Orders now start straight at Design Pending and run through to Completed. Existing jobs on a removed stage were moved to the nearest matching stage automatically.
